FN-WP8XE9-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 181
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Rodger Smitherman
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/28/2023
Senate Bill 181 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Education and the local boards of education to adopt policies, addressing the factors to be
considered when determining whether long-term suspension or expulsion of a student is
appropriate and any other issues that may be deemed relevant and necessary.
